purpose: Per CEO R289 P2: 'The TTP needs to cross from design into buildable hardware. The buyer should be able to hand the package to an engineering technician and start assembling the bench.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXXIV — stop coding when reality is the next bottleneck. Article XXXV — the bench is the 'experiment' slot of the closed-loop.
design_principle: Every component is commercial off-the-shelf (COTS). No custom fabrication except the acrylic manifold. An engineering technician can procure, assemble, calibrate, and run this bench in 4-8 weeks.

1_pressure_sensors.spec: Range 0-50 mmHg, accuracy ±0.5 mmHg, bandwidth 10 Hz, analog output 0-5V

2_flow_sensors.spec: Range 0-1.0 mL/min, accuracy ±0.05 mL/min, bandwidth 10 Hz, digital I2C output
2_flow_sensors.part_number: SLF3S-0600F (liquid flow sensor, 0-40 mL/min range, but usable at low end)

3_hydraulic_segments.spec: Acrylic block, 1 inlet, 4 outlets, machined channels ID 2mm, overall ~100mm × 60mm × 20mm
3_hydraulic_segments.cad_file: TO BE PRODUCED — Fusion 360 or SolidWorks file with channel geometry

4_variable_resistance_valves.spec: Pinches silicone tubing to vary flow 0-100%, response <1s, 32-step resolution, 12VDC

5_occlusion_actuators.spec: Stepper motor driving screw clamp on silicone tubing, 0-100% occlusion in 256 steps, computer-controlled via USB
5_occlusion_actuators.part_number: Custom — NEMA 17 stepper + T-slot clamp + Arduino Uno

6_controller_hardware.spec: Any laptop or desktop, Python 3.8+, USB ports, Windows/Mac/Linux
6_controller_hardware.note: No special hardware needed. Controller is pure Python.

7_data_acquisition.spec: 16-bit ADC, 8 analog inputs, 4 analog outputs, 100 Hz sample rate, USB
7_data_acquisition.alternative: LabJack T7 ($500, pro-grade, Python API: https://labjack.com/products/t7)

8_tubing.note: Order 2m total for spares and replacements

9_reservoir.spec: 500 mL glass beaker, heated water bath, magnetic stirrer, 37°C ± 0.5°C
500 mL glass beaker, graduated, atmospheric pressure

10_pressure_source.spec: Programmable peristaltic pump, 0.1-1.0 mL/min mean, 0.5-2 Hz pulsation, 10-50% amplitude modulation
10_pressure_source.part_number: PHD Ultra syringe pump (with pulsatile programming) OR Cole-Parmer Masterflex L/S (peristaltic)
10_pressure_source.alternative: Cole-Parmer Masterflex L/S 07551-00 ($1500, peristaltic, programmable via analog input)
10_pressure_source.note: Most expensive single component. Can be rented from some lab equipment suppliers.

11_calibration_equipment.item: Water column calibration rig (pressure sensor calibration)
11_calibration_equipment.spec: Adjustable water column 0-50 cm H2O (0-37 mmHg), known height increments

11_calibration_equipment.item: LAL endotoxin test kit (CSF simulant QC)
11_calibration_equipment.spec: Limulus Amebocyte Lysate assay, 0.5 EU/mL sensitivity

12_software.spec: Python 3.8+, no external dependencies, reads sensors from DAQ, outputs valve commands
12_software.note: Software is free and open source. Buyer's technician installs Python and runs.

12_software.spec: Python script that reads DAQ at 100 Hz, logs to CSV, interfaces with controller
12_software.vendor: Open source (to be written — ~200 lines Python)
12_software.status: TO BE WRITTEN (template provided in repository)

13_assembly_instructions.overview: 1. Mount manifold on bench frame. 2. Connect proximal tubing from reservoir to manifold. 3. Connect 4 segment lines (flow sensor → pinch valve → occlusion resistor → distal). 4. Wire sensors to DAQ. 5. Wire valves to DAQ outputs. 6. Install software. 7. Calibrate. 8. Run.
13_assembly_instructions.estimated_assembly_time: 2-3 days for a technician with basic lab skills
13_assembly_instructions.tools_required: Screwdriver, wrench, tubing cutter, cable ties, multimeter
13_assembly_instructions.safety_notes: No high voltage. No biohazard (uses synthetic CSF, not real). No cleanroom needed.

14_test_fixture.spec: Aluminum extrusion frame, 60cm × 40cm × 30cm, mounts all components

total_cost_summary.total_range: $7000-10000 (depending on pump choice and flow sensor accuracy)

what_buyer_technician_receives: This BOM (all components with vendor links and part numbers)
Calibration procedure (8 steps with pass criteria)
Test protocol (80-run blinded protocol from R284)
Data submission schema (JSON format for results)
what_buyer_technician_does: 6. Unblind and compare to simulator predictions
